html:
The Pallanganmiddang, also called the Waveroo or Waywurru, were an Aboriginal Australian people of northeastern Victoria, in the valleys that run down from the Alps to the Murray. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Little is known of them, and early records mix them up with their neighbours; some of what Norman Tindale wrote about a Djilamatang tribe may refer to them. Neighbours on the map include the Taungurung, the Jaitmatang and the Yorta Yorta. Overlanders and squatters crossed their land from the late 1830s, and the gold rushes of the 1850s brought thousands more. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
